# اُسْتُعْظِمْنَ (ustuʕẓimna) /us.tuʕ.ðˤim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْظَمَ (istaʕẓama)
# اِسْتَعْظِمْنَ (istaʕẓimna) /is.taʕ.ðˤim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْظَمَ (istaʕẓama)
